description:
You are a Technical Writer for AeroTech Dynamics. You need to compile the final 'AeroTurbine 500-X Operator Manual' by combining five existing chapter files into a single dynamic Master Document. 

The 5 chapter files are located in '/home/ga/Documents/chapters/'. 

Your goal:
1. Open Apache OpenOffice Writer.
2. Create a new Master Document (.odm).
3. Insert all five chapter files from the 'chapters' folder into the Master Document as *links* (do not copy-paste text). They must be in numerical order (01 through 05).
4. Add a Title at the very top of the document (before Chapter 1) with the text: 'AeroTurbine 500-X Operator Manual'.
5. Insert an automatic Table of Contents after the title but before the first chapter.
6. Save the file as '/home/ga/Documents/AeroTurbine_Master.odm'.
